description.value: The Hotel Eldorado is a historic luxury lakefront property on Okanagan Lake in Kelowna, founded in 1926 by Countess Bubna and celebrating its centennial in 2026. It occupies what the hotel describes as the most coveted spot on Okanagan Lake, with panoramic water views and award-winning dining at its on-site Lakeside Dining restaurant. A touring cyclist staying here arrives at a landmark heritage property with direct lake access and upscale Okanagan hospitality.
